title: Implement conservative sticky-header tap
result: Subtract confirmed header coverage into exposed target fragments, preserving overlap tolerance, finding identity and legacy fallback. Reject uncertain paint, including mask-border and WebKit mask-box sources. The historical consumer report stays partial pending a current screen capture.
evidence: Isolated `pnpm run build` and original `pnpm run test` passed 516 tests in 128 files; coverage was 96.87% statements, 92.09% branches, 95.45% functions and 98.14% lines against unchanged thresholds. Full UI ESLint, native TypeScript, explicit browser-helper ESLint and 24-path Prettier checks exited 0. Scoped canonical Knip found no new issues against the same unbuilt baseline. Independent review's mask finding was corrected; final actual bytes and modes match all 24 tested source paths. No release, consumer deployment or full-workspace green claim is implied.
